name: qlrisk_basel25_capital
title: Basel 2.5 market-risk capital
description: Basel 2.5 capital = max(VaR, m x avg60 VaR) + max(SVaR, m x avg60 SVaR), m = 3 + the backtesting plus factor. Give var_series and svar_series (the last 60 daily 10-day figures) and the backtest exceptions, or give trades to compute 10-day VaR, SVaR and the exception count from a history. Trades take the inputs of each product's qlrisk_price_<product> tool (rates in percent, spreads in basis points, maturity as a tenor like 5Y); confidence levels are in percent (99 = 99%). Inputs: var_series, svar_series, exceptions, trades; the rest (market_data, reporting_currency, history) in the optional `advanced` object. Example: {"var_series": [1000000], "svar_series": [2000000], "exceptions": 3} gives Basel 2.5 capital 9,000,000.00 on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
